title: Most Pointed-To Vertex
body:
A directed graph is given as a list of edges. Each edge u v goes from vertex u to vertex v. Vertex names are strings, and only the vertices that appear in the edges exist. Self-loops u u are allowed and count as an incoming edge.

Find the vertex with the highest in-degree (number of incoming edges). If several vertices tie, choose the one that comes first in alphabetical (ASCII) order.

Function to complete

Complete mostPointedTo(u, v). It returns the vertex name and its in-degree separated by one space, e.g. "C 2".

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: The first line contains N, the number of edges. Each of the next N lines contains two vertex names u v.
out: The vertex name and its in-degree, separated by a space.

samples.ex: E, F, G and H all have in-degree 1, and E comes first.
